== Title ==
<span lang="ja">WED15-17 "セプトイド" ドロイド</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">＊没収値は7から始まる。没収された場合も、このドロイドは場に残るが、没収値は吸収した損耗やダメージの値だけ減少する。ドロイドは没収値が0になった段階でロストする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">複数の腕を持ったメンテナンス・ドロイド。帝国への忠誠心は強い。帝国軍の装備の作動年数を引き伸ばすことにかけては専門家と言える。あだ名はエリアドゥ原生の昆虫から。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[WED15-l7 'Septoid' Droid]].

'''Lore''' — A multi-armed maintenance droid fiercely loyal to the Empire. It is a specialist at extending the operating life of Imperial equipment. The nickname comes from an insect native to Eriadu.

'''Game text''' — Forfeit value begins at 7. Even when forfeited, this droid remains in play, but forfeit value decreases by the attrition or damage absorbed. The droid is lost when forfeit value reaches 0.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese title prints WED15-17. The English original title is WED15-l7. Japanese lore names Imperial equipment. English names Imperial resources. Japanese reduces forfeit by attrition or damage. English names attrition or battle damage.<ref>[[:File:ANewHope-D-wed1517septoiddroid-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[WED15-l7 'Septoid' Droid]].</ref>
